rate_scope: Standard short-context text-token scenario; not an observed Codex subscription charge
assumptions: Published Standard API rates applied as a comparison scenario, irrespective of subscription billing.
Each request has at most 272000 input tokens, verified against complete broker receipts.
Cache-write, tool, regional and infrastructure charges are excluded; missing charge telemetry is unknown.
Requests above 272000 input tokens require a different full-request rate schedule; this scenario refuses an unknown or exceeded short-context bound.
Fast service and regional-processing uplifts are outside this Standard scenario.
